articles.title: Telomere shortening drives replicative senescence in human fibroblasts
articles.abstract: We show that progressive telomere attrition triggers a persistent DNA damage response that establishes replicative senescence in cultured human fibroblasts.

articles.title: Senolytic clearance of telomere-shortened cells restores tissue regeneration
articles.abstract: Pharmacological clearance of cells with critically short telomeres improved regenerative capacity in aged mouse skeletal muscle.
